'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that appeared during the [[By Moon's Grace]] event. He is the childhood friend of [[Xiangli Yao]] and a researcher on the [[Waveworn Phenomenon]]. Devoured by a Waveworn Phenomenon he was accused of triggering, his frequency of regrets and guilt lingered for not being able to share his findings, until it resonated with Xiangli Yao and the Wishing Tree during the [[Moon-Chasing Festival]]. 

Unbeknownst to him, Pascar's classmates and Xiangli Yao were able to prove his innocence by piecing together his research and sharing his findings. In honor of his contribution and sacrifice, they named his theory after him; the ''Pascar Spectrum'' theory. 

==Pascar Spectrum Theory==
A theory on identifying Waveworn Phenomenon frequencies and the prediction of [[Tacet Fields]] formation. It has gained global recognition and greatly advanced the studies on Tacet Fields. Research is on-going on recreating his prototype detector.
